title: HR Business Partner (f/m/d)
description:
You will partner with engineering leaders on organisation and people topics.

What you'll do
- Advise managers on performance, development and organisational design
- Support talent reviews and succession planning
- Coordinate learning offers with the L&D team

What you bring
- 4+ years in HR business partnering
- Strong coaching and communication skills
- Good knowledge of German labour law basics
